decisions.decision: Committee agreed that the state minimum wage changes should also apply to municipalities like Lunenburg, though not a state compliance requirement.
decisions.quote: all agreed that the minimum wage changes that the state had incorporated should also apply to municipalities

decisions.decision: Changing the number of grades and/or steps was deferred to a later time; the committee agreed the work needed doing but not now.
decisions.quote: all agreed that this work needed to be done, but not at this time.

decisions.decision: Only one year's SAP salary grid will be submitted to Town Meeting; grade updates and further grids to follow in next year's Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: we also determined that we would only submit one years sap salary grid for the town meeting.

decisions.decision: J. Belliveau will prepare the edited SAP by-laws version for one final committee review; committee edits due by the beginning of Thursday, March 24, 2022.
decisions.quote: j. belliveau agreed to prepare the edited version for one final review by the committee.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set as a virtual meeting on Monday, March 28, 2022 at 5pm.
decisions.quote: the group agreed to meet again monday march 28, 2022 for a virtual meeting at 5pm
